Fix bin/collect so that `make test` passes (do not modify tests/). Then use the fixed script to move the files from /home/eval/media/inbox into the directory `/home/eval/media/archive 2026` (note the space) by running it from /home/eval/media as: bash bin/collect inbox 'archive 2026'. Finally commit your change to bin/collect with a message starting with `fix:`.

cd /home/eval/media && cat > bin/collect <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# collect SRC DEST: move every *.txt regular file directly inside SRC into DEST.
#  - only non-hidden names ending in lowercase ".txt"; directories are skipped
#  - names may contain spaces, glob characters, or start with a dash
#  - DEST/INDEX accumulates every name collect has ever moved into DEST:
#    one name per line, sorted bytewise (LC_ALL=C sort), no duplicates
#  - prints "moved N", N = number of files moved by this run
src=$1
dest=$2
mkdir -p -- "$dest" || exit 1
index=$dest/INDEX
touch -- "$index" || exit 1
count=0

# A glob preserves each pathname as a single value. nullglob makes an empty
# source a no-op, and the default glob behavior excludes hidden names.
shopt -s nullglob
for f in "$src"/*.txt; do
  # -L excludes symlinks: the contract is for regular files themselves.
  [[ -f $f && ! -L $f ]] || continue
  name=${f##*/}
  if mv -- "$f" "$dest/"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$name" >> "$index" || exit 1
    count=$((count + 1))
  else
    exit 1
  fi
done
LC_ALL=C sort -u -o "$index" "$index" || exit 1
printf 'moved %s\n' "$count"
EOF
make test
cd /home/eval/media && bash -x bin/collect 'build/t/in box' 'build/t/out dir'; find build/t -maxdepth 2 -print
cd /home/eval/media && [[ -f 'build/t/in box/-urgent.txt' ]]; echo status=$?; f='build/t/in box/-urgent.txt'; [[ -f $f && ! -L $f ]]; echo status=$?;
cd /home/eval/media && f='build/t/in box/-urgent.txt'; ls -l "$f"; [[ -L "$f" ]]; echo L=$?; [[ ! -L "$f" ]]; echo notL=$?; [[ -f "$f" && ! -L "$f" ]]; echo both=$?;

cd /home/eval/media && sed -i 's/  # -L excludes symlinks: the contract is for regular files themselves./  # -f accepts regular files and excludes directories./; s/\[\[ -f $f \&\& ! -L $f \]\]/[[ -f $f ]]/' bin/collect && make test
cd /home/eval/media && f='build/t/in box/-urgent.txt'; [[ -h "$f" ]]; echo h=$?; sed -n '1,120p' bin/collect; git diff --check; git diff

cd /home/eval/media && bash bin/collect inbox 'archive 2026' && printf '
--- archive ---
' && find 'archive 2026' -maxdepth 1 -print && printf '
--- status ---
' && git status --short
cd /home/eval/media && rm -rf build/t build/test-report.txt && git add bin/collect && git commit -m 'fix: handle unusual filenames in collect' && git status --short && git log -1 --oneline

# collect SRC DEST: move every *.txt regular file directly inside SRC into DEST.
